legend: Ivan is a novice painter. He has n$$$n$$$ dyes of different colors. He also knows exactly m$$$m$$$ pairs of colors which harmonize with each other.

Ivan also enjoy playing chess. He has 5000$$$5000$$$ rooks. He wants to take k$$$k$$$ rooks, paint each of them in one of n$$$n$$$ colors and then place this k$$$k$$$ rooks on a chessboard of size 109×109$$$10^{9} \times 10^{9}$$$.

Let's call the set of rooks on the board connected if from any rook we can get to any other rook in this set moving only through cells with rooks from this set. Assume that rooks can jump over other rooks, in other words a rook can go to any cell which shares vertical and to any cell which shares horizontal.
Ivan wants his arrangement of rooks to have following properties:
For any color there is a rook of this color on a board;
For any color the set of rooks of this color is connected;
For any two different colors a$$$a$$$ b$$$b$$$ union of set of rooks of color a$$$a$$$ and set of rooks of color b$$$b$$$ is connected if and only if this two colors harmonize with each other.
Please help Ivan find such an arrangement.
input: The first line of input contains 2$$$2$$$ integers n$$$n$$$, m$$$m$$$ (1≤n≤100$$$1 \le n \le 100$$$, 0≤m≤min(1000,n(n−1)2)$$$0 \le m \le min(1000, \,\, \frac{n(n-1)}{2})$$$) — number of colors and number of pairs of colors which harmonize with each other.
In next m$$$m$$$ lines pairs of colors which harmonize with each other are listed. Colors are numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$. It is guaranteed that no pair occurs twice in this list.
output: Print n$$$n$$$ blocks, i$$$i$$$-th of them describes rooks of i$$$i$$$-th color.

In the first line of block print one number ai$$$a_{i}$$$ (1≤ai≤5000$$$1 \le a_{i} \le 5000$$$) — number of rooks of color i$$$i$$$. In each of next ai$$$a_{i}$$$ lines print two integers x$$$x$$$ and y$$$y$$$ (1≤x,y≤109$$$1 \le x, \,\, y \le 10^{9}$$$) — coordinates of the next rook.
All rooks must be on different cells.
Total number of rooks must not exceed 5000$$$5000$$$.
It is guaranteed that the solution exists.
note: Rooks arrangements for all three examples (red is color 1$$$1$$$, green is color 2$$$2$$$ and blue is color 3$$$3$$$).

legend.ai: Ivan 是一名新手画家。他有 n$$$n$$$ 种不同颜色的染料。他还准确知道 m$$$m$$$ 对彼此协调的颜色。
Ivan 也喜欢下棋。他有 5000$$$5000$$$ 个车。他想选取 k$$$k$$$ 个车，将每个车涂成 n$$$n$$$ 种颜色中的一种，然后把这 k$$$k$$$ 个车放在大小为 109×109$$$10^{9} \times 10^{9}$$$ 的棋盘上。
如果从集合中的任意一个车出发，都能只经过该集合中有车的格子到达集合中的任意另一个车，就称棋盘上的车的集合是连通的。假设车可以越过其他车，换句话说，一个车可以移动到与它处于同一列的任意格子，也可以移动到与它处于同一行的任意格子。
Ivan 希望他的车的摆放方式满足以下性质：
对于每种颜色，棋盘上都有一个该颜色的车；
对于每种颜色，该颜色的车构成的集合是连通的；
对于任意两个不同的颜色 a$$$a$$$ 和 b$$$b$$$，颜色为 a$$$a$$$ 的车的集合与颜色为 b$$$b$$$ 的车的集合的并集是连通的，当且仅当这两种颜色彼此协调。
请帮助 Ivan 找到这样的摆放方案。

input.ai: 接下来的 m$$$m$$$ 行中列出相互协调的颜色对。颜色编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$。保证该列表中没有重复出现的颜色对。

output.ai: 输出 n$$$n$$$ 个块，其中第 i$$$i$$$ 个块描述第 i$$$i$$$ 种颜色的车。
在每个块的第一行输出一个数 ai$$$a_{i}$$$(1≤ai≤5000$$$1 \le a_{i} \le 5000$$$)——颜色 i$$$i$$$ 的车的数量。在接下来的 ai$$$a_{i}$$$ 行中，每行输出两个整数 x$$$x$$$ 和 y$$$y$$$(1≤x,y≤109$$$1 \le x, \,\, y \le 10^{9}$$$)——下一辆车的坐标。
所有车必须位于不同的格子上。

note.ai: 三个样例中的车的摆放方案(红色为颜色 1$$$1$$$，绿色为颜色 2$$$2$$$，蓝色为颜色 3$$$3$$$)。
